title: SVGFaith: A Two-Layer Meta-Evaluation of Faithfulness Metrics for Text-to-SVG Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06048v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-SVG systems are commonly evaluated by applying raster-image metrics to rasterised outputs, yet whether these scores capture fine-grained prompt faithfulness remains unclear. We introduce SVGFaith, a two-layer meta-evaluation framework in which the more faithful candidate of each pair is determined by construction or by human judgment. SVGFaith-Diagnostic contains 1,842 controlled contrastive pairs across eight capability axes, split evenly between two directions: two renderings compared against one prompt, and two descriptions compared against one rendering. SVGFaith-Arena contains 1,327 human-annotated comparisons of real generator outputs. On SVGFaith-Diagnostic, CLIP and three other image--text embedding metrics reach at least 0.789 pairwise accuracy on object identity but at most 0.672 on spatial relations and attribute binding, where chance is 0.5. We further introduce SVGFaith-Score, an interpretable pointwise metric. A d

translated_title: SVGFaith：面向文本到SVG生成的忠实度度量的双层元评估
translated_abstract: 文本到SVG系统通常通过将栅格图像度量应用于栅格化输出来进行评估，然而这些分数能否捕捉细粒度的提示词忠实度仍不清楚。我们提出了SVGFaith，一个双层元评估框架，其中每一对样本中更忠实的候选者由构造方式或人工判断确定。SVGFaith-Diagnostic包含1,842个覆盖八个能力维度的受控对比对，均匀分为两个方向：针对同一提示词比较两个渲染图像，以及针对同一渲染图像比较两个描述文本。SVGFaith-Arena包含1,327个对真实生成器输出的人工标注比较。在SVGFaith-Diagnostic上，CLIP及其他三个图像-文本嵌入度量在物体身份方面达到至少0.789的成对准确率，但在空间关系和属性绑定方面最高仅为0.672，而随机水平为0.5。我们进一步提出了SVGFaith-Score，一个可解释的逐点度量指标。
tldr: 提出SVGFaith双层元评估框架，通过诊断性对比集与人工标注竞技场揭示现有图像-文本嵌入度量虽擅长判断物体身份、但在评估文本到SVG生成的空间关系与属性绑定时接近随机水平，并进一步提出可解释的SVGFaith-Score度量。
en_tdlr: SVGFaith, a two-layer meta-evaluation framework combining diagnostic contrastive pairs and human-annotated comparisons, reveals that existing image-text embedding metrics handle object identity well but perform near chance on spatial relations and attribute binding for text-to-SVG generation, and further introduces an interpretable pointwise metric, SVGFaith-Score.
